place.name: Volcán Ecuador
place.description: Volcán Ecuador (Spanish for 'Ecuador Volcano'), also known as Cape Berkeley Volcano, is the smallest of the six shield volcanoes on Isabela Island, one of the Galápagos Islands, with an elevation of 790 m (2,590 ft). It is situated in the west of the Galapagos, straddling the equator, and is the northwestern most point of Isabela Island.
